subject: Possible to run model for one step only?

messages.author: cf47bbe63da1f3ae
messages.subject: Possible to run model for one step only?
parts: I have a large stan model that I would like to use simply as a function for returning the lp value from the parameter values I pass in - I imagine this should be possible, has anyone got a script to do it from R, or some pointers on the process?

I have a large stan model that I would like to use simply as a function for returning the lp value from the parameter values I pass in - I imagine this should be possible, has anyone got a script to do it from R, or some pointers on the process?
